argv:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/bridge-comand-bootstrap"
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/.git" ]; then git clone https://github.com/One-Wave-Universe/Bridge-Comand.git "$ROOT"; fi
git -C "$ROOT" fetch --prune origin main
git -C "$ROOT" checkout --detach origin/main
SCIENCE="/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science"
ONE_WAVE_PROJECT_ROOT="$SCIENCE" bash "$ROOT/hive-pipe/install_chatgpt_terminal_pull.sh"
bash "$ROOT/hive-pipe/install_bridge_lattice_watchdog.sh"
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service
systemctl --user enable --now one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer
printf 'BRIDGE_LATTICE_BOOTSTRAP_OK\n'
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD
systemctl --user is-active one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service
systemctl --user is-active one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer
python3 "$ROOT/hive-pipe/bridge_lattice_watchdog.py" || true
intention: Bootstrap the current Bridge-Comand main runtime and enable the persistent pull and hysteresis watchdog services so any surviving pull listener can repair the bridge lattice automatically.
consequence: Updates only the private bridge runtime and user-level bridge services; leaves the active Science working tree unchanged and prints commit/service/health receipts.
